title: IceCure Highlights Clinical Data and Strong Physician Engagement for ProSense® Breast Cancer Cryoablation at EUSOBI 2026

body_markdown:
***Scientific presentations, research posters and clinical workshops featured ProSense® breast cancer cryoablation and highlighted strong physician engagement across Europe***


CAESAREA, Israel


, October 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[IceCure Medical Ltd.](http://www.icecure-medical.com/) (Nasdaq: ICCM) ("IceCure," "IceCure Medical" or the "Company"), developer of minimally-invasive cryoablation technology that destroys tumors by freezing as an option to surgical tumor removal, announced today that ProSense® breast cancer cryoablation was featured in multiple scientific presentations, research posters and physician workshops at the European Society of Breast Imaging ("EUSOBI") Annual Scientific Meeting 2026, held in Maastricht, the Netherlands. Featured presentations included 12-month clinical data reporting objective response rates of 97.5% among 40 patients treated with cryoablation plus endocrine therapy and 91.7% among 24 patients treated with cryoablation alone.


ProSense® was featured during two key scientific sessions at EUSOBI, reflecting clinical interest in breast cancer cryoablation in Europe. Dr. Lucía Graña-López (Lugo, Spain) presented the clinical potential of cryoablation during her presentation "Beyond Biopsy: Image-Guided Therapy in Practice" during the session "From Target to Treatment: Breast Interventions." Dr. Francesca Pugliese (Florence, Italy) shared her findings from "[Local Tumor Control in Elderly Breast Cancer Patients Ineligible for Surgery: Cryoablation Alone or Combined with Hormonal Therapy](https://eusobi2026.smart-abstract.com/eposter/#/posters/84/presentation/topic/4) " during the session on "Advances in Image-Guided Breast Intervention and Minimally Invasive Therapy."


The Company also hosted two well-attended clinical workshops, led by Dr. Lucía Graña-López (Lugo, Spain) and Dr. Federica Di Naro (Florence, Italy): "From Freeze to Future: Cryoablation as a New Frontier in De-Escalated Breast Cancer Care" and "Reading the Freeze: Practical Imaging Interpretation After Breast Cancer Cryoablation". Each workshop attracted nearly 70 participants.


Two scientific posters by ProSense® users were presented:["From Initial Experience to One-Year Outcomes: Single-Center Efficacy and Safety of Percutaneous Cryoablation for Breast Lesions in Romania"](https://eusobi2026.smart-abstract.com/eposter/#/posters/54/presentation/topic/2) by Dr. Georgiana-Cristiana Camen (Romania) and "[When Enhancement Disappears: The Role of Negative CEM (Contrast Enhancement Mammography) in Predicting Histological Response After Breast Cryoablation](https://eusobi2026.smart-abstract.com/eposter/#/posters/74/presentation/topic/2) " by Dr. Francesca Pugliese (Florence, Italy).


EUSOBI is a leading European organization dedicated to breast imaging and education, bringing together breast radiologists and other specialists from across Europe and internationally. The Annual Scientific Meeting provides a platform for the exchange of clinical knowledge, research and advances in breast imaging and treatment.


"We are thrilled by the tremendous enthusiasm and engagement ProSense® generated throughout EUSOBI," said Eyal Shamir, Chief Executive Officer of IceCure Medical. "From live demonstrations and two key scientific sessions to two workshops attended by nearly 70 participants each, the response was outstanding. The inclusion of ProSense® in scientific posters and the presentation of encouraging 12-month clinical results further demonstrate the growing momentum behind breast cancer cryoablation and the expanding role of ProSense® in advancing minimally invasive care across Europe."


**About IceCure Medical**


IceCure Medical (Nasdaq: ICCM) develops and markets advanced liquid-nitrogen-based cryoablation therapy systems for the destruction of tumors (benign and cancerous) by freezing, as a safe and effective minimally invasive option to surgical tumor removal, with the primary focus areas being breast, kidney, bone and lung cancer. The Company's flagship ProSense® system is marketed and sold worldwide for the indications cleared and approved to date including in the U.S., Europe, and Asia.


ProSense® cryoablation became the first-and-only medical device cleared by the FDA for the local treatment of breast cancer in patients aged 70 years and older with biologically low-risk tumors ≤1.5 cm in size who are treated with adjuvant endocrine therapy, including patients who are not eligible for surgery.
